faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNPA Legal Expert position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the JNPA Legal Expert position is 09-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Legal Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law from a recognized university. A Master's degree in Corporate or Maritime Law and a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in HR Management are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Legal Expert role at JNPA?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Legal Expert position is 45 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Legal Expert position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Legal Expert post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 160,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNPA Legal Expert recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Legal Expert post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Legal Expert post will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Legal Expert position at JNPA is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is JNPA located?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) is located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400707.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria from recognized universities are encouraged to apply.
